description: Expected ShipLoadout jump/fuel outputs. The flat keys below cover fixtures/ships/slef-the-deep-black.json and match EDSY's own MaxJumpRange; `builds` adds further hulls, each naming the artifact it reads and the figure its source asserts. Cross-language validation target.

kraitPhantom.note: A real journal capture, so `sourceMaxJumpRange` is Frontier's own figure rather than a third-party calculator's. Engineered Long Range drive plus a Guardian FSD Booster.

viperMkIV.note: A real journal capture of a wholly UNENGINEERED build, so `sourceMaxJumpRange` is Frontier's own figure for a drive that performs exactly as the catalogue sells it. The Krait Phantom above agrees with the game only after Long Range and a Guardian booster are folded in; this one agrees with nothing folded in, which is what checks the base FSD stats and module masses themselves.
